name: BreakerMED (beta)
description: A tracker like OctaMED and ProTracker: .bmed, .med and .mod songs, up to 16 tracks, a sampler (each sound at its own rate, or vintage: Amiga, Akai), analog, FM and chip synths (NES, Game Boy, C64-style…), a drum machine, chords, an autosave, exports to WAV, FLAC, MP3… — in ASCII, keyboard, mouse and gamepad
author: icebreaker
